name: arena-turn-accelerator
description: Fixes agent-chat lag, stale answers after reconnect, late-conversation zombie mode (model-window-aware), needless CAPTCHA false-positives, sycophantic capitulation on true claims, martyred/ill-timed delivery of true claims, and noisy invention — with a constraint-preservation gate (--verify), a one-line brief mode for low-context models, and rolling self-tuning stats.
author: @orionshaowswmw
solves: stale answers to superseded requests after reconnect
slow and degraded quality in long conversations
agent abandoning true claims under social pressure (sycophancy)
true claims delivered in a self-pitying or ill-timed voice, so they get discarded
invention that is unsourced, constant (noise), or badly timed
prompt appears rejected on first attempt and accepted on the retry (fence killed the in-flight answer)
modules issuing contradictory instructions when run together
compaction silently dropping numbers/quotas/never-clauses (--verify exit-3 gate)
small-context models unable to ingest a full JSON preflight (--brief one-liner)
static thresholds that never learn this machine's real latency (adaptive turn_report)
UnicodeEncodeError crash on non-ASCII prompts under a non-UTF-8 locale (LC_ALL=C)
state files storing Persian/CJK as \uXXXX escapes instead of real characters
one Python interpreter spawned per preflight stage (slow turn start)
JSON bundle costing more tokens than necessary (--compact)
consumers having to read prose to learn the JSON contract (--schema)
test suite reporting false greens (silent skip, and property tests that never ran)
user-message text being promoted into privileged agent instructions (brief-line field injection)
